create.name: Asha Carolyn Young
create.bio:
Asha Carolyn Young works intuitively with energy and is certified by Quantum-Touch both to practise and to teach its Level 1 workshop. She runs Asha's Healing Arts from Gualala, a small town on the Northern California coast. She grew up partly in Thailand and Laos, studied history at UCLA and cultural anthropology at Berkeley, where her doctoral fieldwork among Buddhist nuns near Chiang Mai first drew her towards a spiritual path. Over the years she has practised intensive Theravada meditation, studied laying-on-of-hands in San Francisco, and worked as a writer, editor, teacher of English and abstract painter. The name Asha came to her in meditation after the 1991 Oakland Hills fire, a time when she also began channelling a spirit guide she calls Laya.

In her sessions she blends Quantum-Touch methods, sending life-force energy through her hands, breath and heart field with toning, with other intuitive techniques, working in a meditative state. Sessions take place remotely by phone, Zoom or WhatsApp, so clients can join from anywhere, and she also offers short sessions for pets. She teaches the Quantum-Touch Becoming Energized (Level 1) workshop online, and has spoken about her practice in interviews for Quantum-Touch and on internet radio. She belongs to a local network of holistic practitioners on the coast.

courses.description: Hour-long distance sessions by phone, Zoom or WhatsApp in which Asha works with Quantum-Touch and other intuitive energy methods. Shorter sessions for pets are also available.

courses.title: Quantum-Touch Level 1 Virtual Workshop: Becoming Energized
courses.description: The online foundation course of Quantum-Touch, with no experience needed. Students practise breathing and body-awareness exercises for running life-force energy, work with chakras, toning and distance sessions, and learn to offer energy to animals as well as people.
